risk: Reviewed-label export not sent by day 3
mitigation: request the file in writing on day 1; kill check on day 3
trigger: no file by the end of day 2

risk: Rule overfits the few messages it was written from, so the score looks too high
mitigation: write the rule before the held-out set is opened; score only on the held-out set
trigger: held-out score far below the score on the rule's own messages

risk: Message export columns differ from the lesson 02 sample
mitigation: read the header the day the export arrives (day 2) and map the columns before joining
trigger: a column is missing or renamed

risk: IT freeze on day 8 cuts the sprint by one day
mitigation: know the freeze date on day 1; if it cuts a day, cut the least useful item from the plan

risk: Store managers ask for extra features mid-sprint, such as a shopper app (unpaid scope)
mitigation: send each ask to the backlog or a written change request
trigger: a new request in the team channel

risk: Message export holds customer details beyond what the triage needs
mitigation: export only the needed columns; keep no copies outside the agreed folder
trigger: a file with names, phone numbers or card numbers

risk: Store IT access takes more than one day
mitigation: file the access request on day 0 (before the sprint starts)
trigger: no confirmation by the end of day 1
